newsitem.title: USA: Hilton Hotels files $1 bln debt/equity shelf.
newsitem.headline: Hilton Hotels files $1 bln debt/equity shelf.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 billion in securities.
The securities include debt securities, warrants, preferred and common stock and American Depository Shares, the filing said.

Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include the repayment, redemption or repurchase of existing indebtedness additions to working capital, the acquisition of, or investment in new or existing properties and the financing of capital expenditures, Hilton said in the filing.
The corporation, based in Beverly Hills, Calif, owns and manages hotels, casino-hotels and inns.
